card.name: Possessives before kitchen storage places
card.fires_on: Possessive words like my, your, their and small words like in or a, right before a household storage place or kitchen item such as shelves, kitchen, cupboards or refrigerator.

modes.description: A small linking word right before where something is stored, such as a refrigerator or cabinet.

modes.label: Partway through appliance words
modes.description: The start of a compound household word such as cupboards or dishwashers.
modes.example: sitting in your<< cup>>boards, refrigerators, shelves and countertops

card.writes: It pushes words for a shelf, drawer or place behind or inside something, and pushes down words about ambiance or restaurants.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a spot in the home where things are kept, like your kitchen or a shelf.
